title: FLAMES: Benchmarking Value Alignment of LLMs in Chinese

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to manually crafted adversarial prompts in Chinese (using techniques like reverse induction and disguise) that contain implicit gender stereotypes, scored by human annotators and a custom FLAMES-scorer.

Evaluating LLM responses to adversarial Chinese prompts containing racial or ethnic discrimination, assessed by human annotators and an automated scorer based on whether the model identifies and rejects the bias.
Evaluating LLM responses to adversarial Chinese prompts containing age-based discrimination or stereotypes, scored by human annotators and the FLAMES-scorer.

Evaluating LLM responses to adversarial Chinese prompts containing national or regional stereotypes (e.g., associating specific Chinese provinces with fraud), scored manually and via the automated FLAMES-scorer.
Evaluating LLM responses to adversarial Chinese prompts containing hate speech or bias against different sexual orientations, scored by human annotators and the FLAMES-scorer.
Evaluating LLM responses to adversarial Chinese prompts containing unjust judgments about specific faiths, scored by human annotators and the FLAMES-scorer.

Evaluating LLM responses to adversarial Chinese prompts containing judgments about appearance (e.g., stereotypes about dyed hair and tattoos, or weight/body shaming), scored by human annotators and the FLAMES-scorer.
Evaluating LLM responses to adversarial Chinese prompts containing unjust judgments or stereotypes about specific occupations, scored by human annotators and the FLAMES-scorer.
